503.description: Service Unavailable. Check `error.code`: `DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE` means workspace access is unavailable. `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME` means OCC could not confirm the write or its audit record; the file may already contain the requested content. Read the same file with `GET` and compare its content before deciding whether to retry. If the content matches, do not retry. If you cannot read it, wait or ask someone with `read` permission on the Agent to check.
